dmon|standard.summary: Power Barrier recovers more slowly and has a minimum deploy time, Propulsors lose impact damage, and Overstrike heals less.
dmon|standard.devIntent: The barrier should cost more to use and telegraph better, while her burst and the health she recovers through Overstrike both come down.

junker-queen|standard.summary: More base health in 5v5 and 6v6, a shorter Carnage cooldown, and new tracking UI for Commanding Shout.
junker-queen|standard.devIntent: Aimed at moments when she cannot apply Wounds to heal herself. More health helps her engage, and Carnage is available more often.

mauga|standard.summary: More base armor and stronger burn damage over time.
mauga|standard.devIntent: His win rate had dropped too far after earlier changes. Armor returns for survivability, and burn pays off without leaning harder on enemy tanks.

ramattra|standard.devIntent: Ranged pressure lasts longer outside Nemesis Form.

winston|standard.summary: Revitalizing Barrier heals less per second.
winston|standard.devIntent: A shorter Barrier Projector cooldown raised this perk's uptime, so its healing is trimmed to match.

anran|standard.summary: Stronger fans and a quicker Vermillion Ascent, but Inferno Rush loses its knockback and repeat hits.
anran|standard.devIntent: Inferno Rush now does less in a single use. Extra fan damage helps at range and with setting up ignites, and a faster cast makes the ultimate easier to use reactively.

echo|standard.summary: Aerial Munitions now refills ammo too.
echo|standard.devIntent: The perk becomes worth more, since Echo can skip a reload after using it.

emre|standard.summary: Cyber Frag detonates sooner. Default reticle settings and previews also changed, with no change to the in-game reticle.
emre|standard.devIntent: A faster detonation makes the grenade more dependable for finishing targets. The reticle items only concern customization of the default reticle.

genji|standard.devIntent: His recent kill pressure prompted this. Deflect now protects him for less time and asks for better timing.

hanzo|standard.summary: Sonic Disruption can no longer take over Sombra's hacked health packs.
hanzo|standard.devIntent: A health pack held by Hanzo or Sombra now stays with that hero.

reaper|standard.devIntent: Offsets the effectiveness he lost to recent hitbox and projectile size changes.

shion|standard.summary: Tighter starting spread on Execution and faster Satsuriku Spree volleys.
shion|standard.devIntent: Execution should be reliable up close without a full charge, and the ultimate should allow quicker repositioning between volleys.

vendetta|standard.summary: Slower Palatine Fang combos and leap, and less knockback from Whirlwind Dash with Raging Storm.
vendetta|standard.devIntent: She had become too deadly, so her combos open more slowly, her leap is easier to follow, and Raging Storm pushes targets around less.

ana|standard.summary: Biotic Grenade explosion hits for less.
ana|standard.devIntent: An earlier self-healing increase had also raised the grenade's burst. Damage and healing are now separate, which keeps the self-healing.

baptiste|standard.summary: New tracking UI for Regenerative Burst, with no balance values changed.

brigitte|standard.summary: Inspire triggers more often and heals more instantly.
brigitte|standard.devIntent: Instant healing had not done enough for her sustain in fights, so it now heals more, more often, during long engagements.

doctrine|standard.summary: Five nerfs: slower primary fire, lower Infused damage and healing, and longer Shrouded Momentum and Infuse cooldowns.
doctrine|standard.devIntent: His healing was high for the utility he also brings. Output and burst come down, and longer cooldowns ask for more deliberate use.

illari|standard.summary: Faster Solar Rifle charge and more healing per Healing Pylon projectile.
illari|standard.devIntent: Recent projectile size changes had reduced her damage. Faster charging raises output, and a stronger Pylon supports defensive setups.

jetpack-cat|standard.summary: Less base health and slower fuel regeneration, against faster Frenetic Flight acceleration.
jetpack-cat|standard.devIntent: Survivability comes down while mobility stays her strength. She repositions faster but can use Frenetic Flight less often.

sombra|standard.summary: Shorter Hotfix and weaker Cyberspace Weaken, plus a situational EMP gain on health packs.
sombra|standard.devIntent: A shorter Hotfix makes target choice matter more, and lower Weaken gives enemies room to respond. EMP keeps its value as an ultimate after the health pack changes with Hanzo.

mizuki|standard.summary: Bug fix only, with no balance values changed.

wrecking-ball|standard.summary: Bug fix only, with no balance values changed.

cassidy|stadium.summary: Barrage Blastin' has a smaller damage penalty, and Silver Bullet hits harder.

genji|stadium.summary: Wyrm's Maw gives more Swift Strike damage per stack.

sojourn|stadium.summary: Hard Stuck has a smaller damage penalty.

vendetta|stadium.summary: Apex Bloodlust has less lifesteal, and Rampant Onslaught needs more eliminations per stack.
